summary: Frontend-only validation of menu PDF corrections and events flyer replacement. All requested checks passed: menu label 'Menù' renders; all 3 tabs (cucina 26 items, pizza 37 items, vini 16 items) render fully; corrected descriptions/names verified verbatim (Tortino cioccolato, Capricciosa, Romana, Tre Porcellini, Calzone farcito, Calzone a scelta, Cunzata, Vino Bianco frizzante, Vino Rosso Merlot); spot-check prices correct (Margherita €6,00, Marinara €5,00, Tomahawk €24,00, Valpolicella Ripasso €39,00). Events homepage section keeps carousel + blocks + 'Vedi gli eventi' CTA (data-testid='events-cta'); clicking CTA navigates to /eventi where festa-poster src=/events/notte-bianca.jpg (image loads, naturalWidth=2538). Italian festa-title='La Notte Bianca'; content includes 'Spaghetti alle vongole', 'Sorbetto al limone', '€35', 'Prenotazione obbligatoria'; old 'Festa Anni 90' / 'Anni 90' strings are NOT present. Language switcher produces correct titles: EN 'The White Night', DE 'Die Weiße Nacht', FR 'La Nuit Blanche'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Menu & events verified against PDF/new flyer on public URL. Use ?static=1 to skip preloader. Menu items rendered via data-testid='menu-item' inside #menu with tabs data-testid='menu-tab-{cucina|pizza|vini}'. Events page at /eventi uses data-testid='events-page', 'festa-poster', 'festa-title'. Language switcher: data-testid='language-switcher-button' + 'lang-option-{it|en|de|fr}'.
